subject: ANGL
title: English Language – Form 5
source: Form 5 syllabus by week (3 h/week); dates worked out from the school calendar

chapters.title: Module 1: Family and social life (15 h)

lessons.title: Week 1: Developing study skills; structure of the GCE O/L English paper – simple present and present continuous (review)
Week 2: Taking part in associations; writing minutes – present perfect and past perfect; sounds /θ/ and /ð/
Week 3: Settling disputes in the family; gender issues; argumentative essay – connectives of addition and contrast; thesis and topic sentences
Week 4: Wholesome eating; debate on eating out – plural of compound words; sounds /ʃ/ and /ʒ/
Week 5: Educational opportunities; formal letter of application – prepositions and prepositional phrases

chapters.title: Module 2: The world of business (15 h)

lessons.title: Week 7: Combating unemployment; narrative essay – past tenses (simple, continuous, perfect); sounds /s/ and /z/
Week 8: Generating income and managing money; one-word essay – collocations
Week 9: Online shopping and business; expository essay and business letters – adverbs (review); stress on homographs
Week 10: Managing natural, material, human and time resources – the conditional tense
Week 11: Creating common initiative groups (CIGs); writing a report – conditionals (continued); abbreviations and acronyms

chapters.title: Module 3: Environment, health and wellbeing (15 h)

lessons.title: Week 13: Pollution and environmental protection – punctuation: the apostrophe
Week 14: Self-medication and its ills; letter to the editor – active and passive voice (review); sounds /aʊ/ and /əʊ/
Week 15: Managing mental health; picture essay – nouns in apposition; silent consonants
Week 16: The weather, global warming and climatic conditions – quantifiers (either/or, neither/nor, each, every, any, none)
Week 17: Tourism; descriptive essay – phrasal verbs and articles
Week 19: Discipline at school and at home – reported speech (review)
Week 20: Rights and duties of a citizen; directed writing – subject-verb agreement
Week 21: Virtues and vices in society – word formation (affixation)
Week 22: Cultural values and practices: widowhood rites, succession, enthronement – action and linking verbs; syllabification
Week 23: Major historical events and personalities; descriptive essay – adjectives (review)

chapters.title: Module 5: Media, communication, science and technology

lessons.title: Week 25: Using the internet for study and employment; directed writing – revision
Week 26: Accessing global issues in the media; internet security – idiomatic expressions
